notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Trainer.cs implements the trainer session and window: CMSG_TRAINER_LIST request with range/flag gating, SMSG_TRAINER_LIST decode, ClassTrainer four-piece shell, greeting text, 11-row service list with state coloring (grey known / gold available / red unaffordable-unavailable), wheel + real draggable scrollbar, selection detail pane (icon in EmptySlot, name, level requirement, cost, description), Train button (CMSG_TRAINER_BUY_SPELL) with success/failure packets and learned-spell observation, Exit + close button, requirements tooltip per row.
